Company Description   Prismapar is an advisory and venture firm specializing in M&A, corporate finance, business development, and venture funding for companies in expansion or strategic repositioning. The firm supports clients across business growth, mergers and acquisitions, strategic sales, and capital raising from banks, private equity funds, and capital markets. Proficiency in Financial Statements and Financial Reporting, with the ability to interpret and prepare key reports.  Advanced Analytical Skills, including experience with financial modeling, data analysis, and scenario evaluation. Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Interest in corporate transactions, venture funding, and Latin American markets; previous exposure to advisory or investment environments is a plus.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.   Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.  *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*    O que oferecemos?    Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora  Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos   de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados  .  Mentorias semanais   com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.  Plataforma exclusiva   para acompanhamento das aulas.  Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.  Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.  Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).  Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.  Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.    Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?    Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.    Necessário:    Maior de 18 anos  , fluente em Português e outro idioma.  Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais   para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.  Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.  Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.    O diferencial?    Aqui você é mais que um professor.    Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas  , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.  Esta não é uma vaga CLT  , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.  Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.  Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii   com certeza é o seu lugar.  Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.   Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!  O que eu faço?    Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida  Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as  Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados  Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as  Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as  Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as    Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.  QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?    Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.  Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.  Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.    Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.  Seja diferente, seja independente

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.  O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.  Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.  Sobre a Oportunidade:    A Vidya é uma empresa de tecnologia aplicada à engenharia industrial, com atuação voltada ao desenvolvimento de soluções digitais para gestão de integridade de ativos em ambientes industriais complexos, especialmente em setores como óleo e gás, offshore, mineração, siderurgia e petroquímica. Suas plataformas apoiam atividades como inspeção, manutenção, monitoramento de corrosão, segurança operacional e tomada de decisão, integrando dados industriais, modelos 3D, Digital Twin, inteligência artificial e visão computacional. Em um momento de crescimento e transformação estratégica, a empresa busca fortalecer sua capacidade de escalar produtos e entregar valor de forma cada vez mais eficiente aos seus clientes.  A proposta une IA, LLMs, análise de dados, APIs e automação para criar soluções capazes de apoiar a tomada de decisão, melhorar indicadores operacionais e ampliar a escalabilidade do modelo de negócio.  Buscamos um perfil com visão analítica, domínio técnico e vontade de transformar desafios operacionais em soluções inteligentes, escaláveis e de alto impacto.  Formação Acadêmica:    Doutorado completo em   Ciência da Computação, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas.  Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.  Idioma:   Inglês para leitura  Projeto:   Arquitetura e Aplicação de Agentes de Inteligência Artificial para Automação de Operações de Product Business Operations (BPO) em Plataformas Industriais  Principais Atividades:     Desenho, implementação e evolução dos agentes de IA;  Automação dos fluxos operacionais da área de BPO;  Integração das soluções com os sistemas internos da Vidya, garantindo escalabilidade e robustez técnica    Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos    Conhecimento em inteligência artificial aplicada;  Aprendizado de máquina e desenvolvimento de agentes inteligentes;  Experiência em LLMs, automação de processos, arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e integração de APIs em ambientes corporativos.    Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais    Conhecimento em novas ferramentas de IA aplicada, tais como o Claude, para utilização dentro do ambiente empresarial para automação de processos. title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Business Analyst    Role Overview    The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers.  The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals.  The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user.  Principal Duties and Responsibilities    Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members.  Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts.  Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes.  Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements.  Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation.  Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members.  Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.  Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options.  Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management.  Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes.  Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions.  Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.  Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.  Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution.  Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities.  Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency.  Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs.  Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders.  Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment.  Maintain regular and predictable attendance.  Perform other duties as assigned.    Job Specifications  Education and Experience  Required Education and Experience    Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.  Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst.  Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements.  Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams.  Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements.  Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment.    Preferred    Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects.  Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives.  General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules.  Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects.  Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin.  Insurance or financial services industry experience.  Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience.    Skills and Abilities    Required    Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills.  Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions.  Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.  General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes.  Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions.  Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills.  Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.  Strong oral and written communication skills.  Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge.  Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation.  Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work.  Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment.  Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.  Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods.  Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements.  Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables.    Technical Expectations    The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist.  Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Portuguese Language Expert em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.  In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.  This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.  Key Responsibilities    As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:  Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.  Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.  Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.  Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.  Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.  Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.  Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.  Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.  Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.    Required Language Proficiency    Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.  Proficiency is required in:  Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)  Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)  Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)    The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.  Required Experience    The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:  PII identification or privacy annotation  Risk assessment or content safety annotation  Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling  Named Entity Recognition or entity classification  LLM response evaluation  AI chatbot evaluation  Policy-based content moderation  Sensitive content classification  Gen AI or LLM training data creation    Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.  Skills and Competencies    We are looking for candidates who have:  Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.  Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.  A close attention to detail and consistency.  Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.  Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.  Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.  Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.  Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.  Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.    Qualifications    Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.  Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.  Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.  Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.    Engagement Terms    This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.  Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.  Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.  Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.    What We Offer    Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams.  Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects.  Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives.  Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities.  A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.    Application Note    This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

title: Promo Writer (Brasil)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Promo Writer (Brasil) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Promo Writer     Location: Remote  Position Type: Contract  Company: Pocket FM  About Us    At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.  Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.  The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.  You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.  Key Responsibilities    1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing    Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series.  Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance.  Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series.  Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production.  Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.    2. Adaptation & Localization    Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese.  Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience.  Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market.  Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.    3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement    Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity.  Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments.  Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction.  Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards.    4. Production-Ready Script Delivery    Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required.  Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute.  Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed.  Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.    5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses    Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement.  Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization.  Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos.  Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance.    6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration    Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams.  Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines.  Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets.  Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.    7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization    Use GenAI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement.  Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards.  Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength.  Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.    Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field.  Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content.  Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences.  Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese.  Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers.  Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred.  Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams.  Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output.  Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables.  Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment.  Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.    Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.  They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Arquitetura Azure
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Arquitetura Azure em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

O que buscamos:     Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Azure).     Responsabilidades:     Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).  Implementar o ZeroLayer Router HTTP (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).  Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.  Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).  Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.  Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.  Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.  Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.    Requisitos Obrigatórios    Azure em produção: AKS, VNet, bancos gerenciados, mensageria e IAM  Capacidade de discutir e implementar Cell-Based Architecture  Terraform para IaC multi-célula com pipelines de CI/CD para infra  Kubernetes em produção: rede, RBAC, Helm e autoscaling  Redes: DNS, TLS/PKI, firewalls e roteamento em cloud  Mensageria: Kafka ou equivalente em contexto de roteamento assíncrono  Bancos relacionais e não relacionais em contexto de sharding  Padrões de autenticação: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 e identidades gerenciadas  Observabilidade em produção: métricas, logs e traces distribuídos.    Desejável:    Experiência prévia com Cell-Based Architecture em produção  Visão multicloud: workloads simultâneos em Azure e AWS  ArgoCD (GitOps), incluindo ApplicationSets para deploy em múltiplas células  Service mesh (Istio, Cilium) e mTLS inter-serviço  Datadog: APM, Log Management, SLO tracking e alertas por célula  Certificações: CKA, AZ-305, Terraform Associate ou equivalentes.    Descrição comportamental:     Procuramos uma pessoa que:  Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa   em suas atribuições;  Tenha coragem   para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;  Transforme ideias em soluções criativas   e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;  Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas  ;  Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo  ;  Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras   no âmbito tecnológico.    Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.  #VempraGFT    #VamosVoarJuntos    #ProudToBeGFT

What we’re looking for    3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment. Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams.  Excellent written and spoken English; full professional fluency is required.  Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams.  Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output.  A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure.  Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth.  Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking. Job Description: Customer Support Specialist  Who We Are:     Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.    Your Role:    As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.  You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk  or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.  Why this role matters:     Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.  Responsibilities:    Support delivery:   Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.    Service quality and consistency:   Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.    Product and platform expertise:   Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.    Cross-functional collaboration:   Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.    Retention and expansion signal:   Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.    Continuous improvement:   Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard    What We’re Looking For:    Must-haves:    Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one.  Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility.  Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone.  Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants.  Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection.  Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.    Nice-to-haves:    Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO).  Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product.  Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows.  Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

This role is open to candidates based in Brazil only.    About SigmaMD  SigmaMD is changing the way people manage their health. We build the platform where modern clinics run their entire business on — clinician apps, patient apps, and the admin tooling behind them — covering charting, a number of embedded AI tools, e-prescribing, labs, scheduling, patient messaging, and the money.   About this role  We're looking for a senior product designer who wants more than screens. You'll own the design of our most demanding domain end to end — the research, the flows, the interface, and a real share of the product thinking behind it.   Your primary surface is Payments & Billing.   Today our practices bill patients and employers directly: memberships and plan cycles, employer contracts with coverage rules, eligibility roster feeds, proration, invoices and charge items, refunds and reissues, superbills, and card/ACH processing through our merchant partner.   This is not a domain you can design from a wireframe kit. When a patient joins on the 14th, when an employer covers 60% up to a cap, when a membership pauses mid-cycle and is reinstated — someone has to understand exactly what the numbers do, then design an interface that makes it obvious to a physician who is not an accountant. That person is you.   And the next chapter is big.   We're expanding into full insurance billing — claims submission, eligibility verification, remittance posting, denials workflow, and prior authorization via a clearinghouse partnership — so hybrid practices can run membership revenue and insurance revenue side by side. Designing it is the most interesting problem we can offer.   You won't only touch billing.   Money and care delivery are inseparable here: a charge item comes from an order, a superbill comes out of a signed note, eligibility gets checked at booking. Expect to design across the EHR itself wherever it meets the money. Fellow product designers, engineers, QA, and our customer success team are all people you'll collaborate with daily. Nobody reports to you, but we expect seniority to show up as more than shipping: reviewing work, sharing the reasoning behind your decisions, and helping the designers around you grow is part of how this role operates day to day. You get real ownership of your surfaces, and a company small enough that you can take any question straight to the person who can answer it.   What you'll do  Design it.    Own the full design arc for Payments & Billing: research, information architecture, flows, prototypes, and production-ready screens in Figma.   Make dense, numbers-heavy interfaces feel calm and obvious. A physician should never have to think about how billing works.   Extend our design system where the domain demands patterns we don't have yet.     Own the product thinking.    Shape the roadmap for your area alongside our team and customers.   Write the stories engineering builds from — which field, which state transition, what happens at the boundary, what the money does. Our specs are precise, and designers write them here.   Help define our move into insurance billing.     Talk to customers — and onboard them yourself.    Be on calls and in writing with US physicians and practice administrators, and personally onboard new practices. Sitting with a physician while they configure their billing is the best research you'll ever run.   Turn messy operational complaints into design decisions. Most of our best work starts as a frustrated support thread.     Do the math.    Model pricing and fee scenarios, reason about proration and cycle boundaries, and stress-test flows against edge cases before they reach a spec. Ambiguity in a billing interface becomes a real charge on someone's bank account.     Make the design team better.    Review other designers' work, explain the why behind your decisions, and share what you know. Some of that is people, and some of it is what the team builds on: the design system, the patterns, the way decisions get documented.      What we're looking for  1. Exceptional written and spoken English — our single most important requirement.   You'll be on live calls with US clinicians, writing specs engineers build from, and writing directly to customers. We assess this seriously and early.   2. Startup experience in a design or product role.   You've worked somewhere small enough that you owned outcomes, not tickets — where the answer to \"who decides this?\" was you. Senior Product Designer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or founder all count.   3. A technical background.   You don't need to ship production code, but you should read an API contract comfortably, reason about a data model, and hold your own in a technical discussion without deferring. Front-end experience or a CS/Engineering background is a strong plus.   4. Genuinely comfortable with numbers.   You'll design around money. You should enjoy — not tolerate — building the spreadsheet, deriving the proration formula, and stress-testing a pricing model against edge cases.   Plus:  5+ years   in product design with real ownership of a domain; a portfolio of complex, information-dense product work (not marketing pages); expert Figma; and writing precise enough that a developer never has to guess.   Who you might be  You're a designer who got restless about  why  you were designing it, and started owning the product decision itself. Maybe you effectively ran the roadmap for your area at a SaaS company. Maybe you co-founded something small and had to be the designer, the front-end developer, and the person who understood the unit economics all at once. What matters is that you've held both halves at once, been close enough to the code to be dangerous, and had to defend a number to someone who cared about it.   Nice to have  Revenue cycle management or insurance billing — claims, eligibility, remittance, denials, prior authorization, clearinghouse integrations. This is where we're heading, and the hardest thing on this list to teach.   Payments, billing, subscriptions, or fintech (merchant processing, ACH, PCI, benefits eligibility feeds).   Healthcare, digital health, or EHR experience   Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS, design tokens) and design-system authorship.   Comfort with AI-assisted workflows for research, spec writing, and analysis.     Our values  Teamwork, empathy, and innovation — and caring that on the other end of every decision is a physician trying to run an independent practice and their patients.

Experience developing dashboards and reporting to monitor forecast accuracy, inventory performance, and operational KPIs.  Demonstrated success driving business process improvements and implementing planning best practices. title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Country Manager- Brazil em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About VelaFi    At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.  Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.  Position Overview    VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil   to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity.  Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements.  The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.    Location    Remote – Brazil    Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.  Key Responsibilities    Executive Leadership    Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil.  Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure.  Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives.  Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.    Regulatory & Corporate Governance    Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities.  Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN)  , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders.  Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.    Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.    Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.  Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.    Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships    Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil.  Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners.  Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth.  Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.    Cross-Functional Leadership    Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams.  Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America.  Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.    Organizational Development    Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.  Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.  Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.    Qualifications    Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field.  MBA or other advanced degree preferred.  10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.  Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth.  Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment.  Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders.  Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.    Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.  Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.    Nice to Have    Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.  Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil.  Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers.  Experience working within multinational or global organizations.  Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure.  Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.      Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)    Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:  Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.  Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.  Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.  Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.  Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.    Why Join VelaFi?    At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement.  Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments.  Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset  , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets.  Equal Employment Opportunity    VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Estamos em busca de um(a) AI Filmmaker inovador(a), especializado(a) na criação de vídeos cinematográficos e fotorrealistas utilizando ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial Generativa e fluxos de produção híbridos. Transformar roteiros, storyboards e briefings criativos em narrativas audiovisuais impactantes.  Projetar e executar fluxos de produção baseados em IA, desde a pré-visualização até a entrega final. Experiência com fluxos de trabalho envolvendo compositing, inpainting, upscaling e interpolação de quadros (frame interpolation).  Proficiência em softwares de edição de vídeo.  Conhecimento em pipelines de color grading e acabamento cinematográfico.  Familiaridade com a integração de conteúdos gerados por IA em fluxos tradicionais de pós-produção. The more startups that exist, survive and thrive, the better the world we all get to live in. We work behind the scenes to help our clients win.   We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We're transparent with each other and with our clients. We're professional, inclusive and autonomous, and we're building a culture that's trust-based, genuinely fun, and pushes each of us to keep learning.   Check out more of what we do here:   🚀 The Role    We're looking for a driven person to join our team of Operations Specialists - the main conduit through which all of our clients' back-office operations run  , including Human Resources, Finance, Payroll and Compliance.   As an Operations Specialist, you work directly with US startup founders to project manage their most critical operational matters. You work alongside a Chief Chore Officer, who owns the relationship - you own the operations.   In short: you're the point person who keeps the lights on.   These responsibilities are often tactical. But tactical doesn't mean thoughtless - and as you build trusted relationships with the founders you support, the work becomes strategic too. Our best Operations Specialists end up being the person a founder calls first.    Some Examples Of The Work We Do    Tactical responsibilities still require judgment and thoughtfulness   - “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?”  Work that gets genuinely strategic   - e.g., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times, when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients.  Research and problem-solving for back-office edge cases.   An unusual filing. A regulator with an unhelpful website. A vendor who's gone quiet. Something that has genuinely never come up before. You go and find the answer  Choosing tools and vendors, with the cost in mind.   Our clients are early-stage and often bootstrapped. You research the options, compare them properly, and recommend what actually fits their budget - not the biggest name in the market. We expect you to know what things cost and to raise it before anyone asks you to.  Contributing to our knowledge base.   Internal, client-facing, and public-facing. Every startup on earth reinvents the wheel on HR, Finance and Legal Ops, and it drives us crazy. We're building a reusable source of wisdom and best practice - and what you learn goes into it, so nobody has to solve the same problem twice.  Internal projects that make Chore stronger.   SOPs, systems, dashboards, operational improvements - scoped, executed and delivered by you.    One note on scope:    unlike an internal Chief of Staff, this role doesn't extend into bespoke areas like go-to-market, analytics or partnerships.   🧠 What We're Looking For    Required    3+ years of work experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties.   This is required, not preferred. What matters most is that you were the person responsible for outcomes, not a contributor to someone else's.    Strongly preferred    HR, Payroll, Finance or Compliance operations experience   (We're not looking for a recruitment or sales background)     And you're probably a fit if…    You're a total geek for better processes   - more standardisation, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient.  Ticking items off your list while thinking \"how could I do this more efficiently?\"  brings a smile to your face.   There's always more to do for clients, and you thrive on getting things done  You're obsessed with using AI and technology to work smarter   - you don't wait to be told about a new tool, you've usually already tested it  You love building deep, trusting relationships   with dynamic founders across many industries  You're smart, detail-oriented, a natural context-switcher, with GREAT communication skills    You have a deep dedication to client service   and doing right by people - going above and beyond to make sure our clients love us  You can focus in stressful situations and prioritise almost automatically    You're open to giving and receiving feedback  , up, down and sideways, using the Radical Candor method  You start solving before you start asking.   When something breaks and there's nobody available, you get going. You escalate with a recommendation, not a question  You don't mind the unsexy part of running a startup   - dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboardings, and basically doing the \"startup plumber\" work. It might smell, but a strong back office is foundational to success  You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long term (2+ years).   This role might be a stepping stone, and we celebrate our team members' growth - but if you apply, our assumption is that you'd prefer a job you can see yourself in for several years over one you expect to leave within twelve months     Nice to have, not required    An understanding of bookkeeping, accounting, or early-stage startup finance  Comfort with ClickUp, Slack, Notion, and Google Suite      Why This Role Is Special    You will run real companies behind the scenes.   Very few roles give you this much impact this early  You get ownership from day one.   From the moment you start, you are running real systems for real companies - not shadowing or waiting to be handed responsibility  You get rare visibility.   You'll see how multiple US startups actually operate behind the scenes. Operators almost never get this  You work with sharp, ambitious teammates   who care deeply about doing things well  You will grow faster than you imagined -   start by partnering with experienced Chief of Staffs      Compensation & Logistics    Compensation.   We believe in full transparency. Below is what we pay by market, with quarterly bonuses of up to 30% based on performance.    India   - $12K USD/year  Nigeria / Africa   - $10.4K USD/year  LATAM   - $13K USD/year    Note   : we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics.   Equity.   All team members receive equity. Further grants are awarded based on performance and tenure.  Benefits   (all eligible after you complete the 60-day probation period)   Up to $250/month WFH stipend  Up to $50/month wellness stipend  Location.   We're remote-first and proud of it. If you're good with our compensation and US working hours, the world is yours.  Schedule.   US business hours, Eastern or Pacific Time. This is mandatory and it can be challenging. If you can't consistently work EST or PST hours, this role won't be a good fit.    🦨 Read Before Applying    We believe in being upfront about the hard parts.  US hours are required and can be demanding.   This may not be suitable for everyone  Remote work has real challenges.   You need reliable WiFi, power backup, and a quiet workspace  High ambiguity.   You must create structure, not wait for it  Extreme context-switching.   You'll juggle multiple clients, internal stakeholders and projects at the same time  Feedback fluency.   You must be comfortable giving and receiving feedback up, down and sideways  High ownership.   Minimal hand-holding. You are expected to self-manage  Client-facing pressure.   Founders move fast and expect clarity  60-day fully paid probation period.   We want everyone to feel set up for success from day one. In your first 60 days, success looks like confidently owning and running core client workflows with minimal oversight and communicating proactively with clients and teammates.    If this energizes you rather than intimidates you, you're probably a great fit.  ❤️ Our Values    Delight All Stakeholders.   Make work feel easier, clearer and more thoughtful for clients, teammates and yourself  Meritocracy.   We reward value created - not longevity  Experiment & Adapt.   Try things, learn fast, improve continuously  Assume Good Intentions.   Take feedback well. Fix things proactively. Be a force multiplier      How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY)    Please read this section carefully - following the instructions is part of how we assess applications.  Your application has two parts. Both are required.    Step 1 - Record a short video    Record one video, no longer than 3 minutes  , answering these two questions:  1. Why is this role not a good fit for most people, and why is it for you?    2. Pick something from the last three years that was yours to lead on your own - not something you supported someone else on. Tell us what you decided, who else was involved and what they did, and what it cost or saved.     A few notes:    Answer both questions in a single video (loom preferred)  We're not judging production quality - we want to hear how you think  We appreciate the use of AI. We don't want AI-generated answers (trust us, we can tell). Tell us your story, in your own words, please.     Step 2 - Submit the application form    (Only once your video is recorded)   Form:     When sharing your resume, please name as follows:   Firstname.Lastname.OS - Resume - for example, Jane.Doe.OS - Resume. PDF preferred.  What Happens Next    We move quickly, and we'd rather you know exactly what's coming:  We review your application and video   - usually within a week  A 30-minute screening call  , so we can get to know you  A paid case study   - 1 to 2 hours of work, with 72 hours to complete it. You'll receive a payment for your time  Four interviews  , to meet different team members including a Chief Chore Officer (30 mins), a current Operations Specialist (30 mins), our head of Client Operations (30 mins) and finally our CEO (15 mins)  Offer rollout      We aim to go from application to decision in around three weeks.

title: Senior Sustainability Analyst
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Sustainability Analyst em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

This is Energizer Holdings, Inc.    Energizer Holdings responsibly creates products to make lives easier and more enjoyable. To do this, we lean into our culture as an organization – we win together, while serving each other, with a willingness to act boldly, all while doing right. Our colleagues hail from all backgrounds, nationalities and walks of life, but our shared mission and purpose make us one team. Because we’re a global organization, you will always have opportunities to learn, grow and develop in your career. We support flexible working arrangements wherever possible.   Position Summary    The Senior Sustainability Analyst plays a key role in advancing the company's sustainability strategy, reporting, compliance, and performance management programs. This position leads sustainability data collection, greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, reporting, assurance, and audit activities. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across global operations, the role ensures data integrity, transparency, and alignment with corporate sustainability goals and external reporting requirements. The role also provides project management support for sustainability initiatives, including coordinating meetings, tracking action items, developing presentations and communications, and supporting implementation of strategic priorities and programs.   The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with experience managing complex sustainability data and reporting processes across multiple global facilities.   Responsibilities    Specific Accountabilities      Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Accounting & Emissions Management:   Lead global Scope 1, Scope 2, and applicable Scope 3 GHG inventory development, data collection, emissions calculations, and reporting.   Maintain GHG methodologies, documentation, and data quality in alignment with the GHG Protocol and regulatory requirements.   Partner with internal and external stakeholders to validate emissions data, support reduction initiatives, and ensure audit readiness.     Sustainability Reporting & Disclosure Management:  Lead project management and execution of the annual Sustainability Report, including timelines, stakeholder engagement, and approvals.   Coordinate content development, source documentation, communications, training materials, and website disclosures.     Assurance, Audit & Internal Controls:  Serve as the primary contact for sustainability audits and external assurance engagements.   Coordinate audit requests, maintain supporting evidence, and ensure effective reporting controls and governance.   Identify risks, implement corrective actions, and support successful completion of audits and assurance reviews.     Program Support:   Support implementation of evolving sustainability standards, frameworks, controls, and documentation processes.   Coordinate project meetings, stakeholder engagement, action-item tracking, and program documentation.     What we are looking for    Required Skills and Experience     Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.   Minimum of 3+ years of experience in greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, applying the Greenhouse Gas Protocol and related emissions reporting methodologies across multiple global facilities and operations.   Experience with external GHG emissions audits, assurance engagements, and verification processes.   Knowledge of sustainability reporting frameworks, regulations, and assurance requirements, including GRI, ISSB, CSRD, and related disclosure standards.   Proficiency with sustainability data management systems (e.g., Metrio) and advanced Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.   Strong project management, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.   Experience supporting corporate sustainability reports, ESG disclosures, and cross-functional initiatives across global operations.   Professional certifications in sustainability, environmental management, or GHG accounting are a plus.     Come join us!    Energizer is an equal opportunity employer, and we prohibit discrimination based on age, color, disability, marital or parental status, veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!     Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!    A Idioma Independente  , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.  Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.    Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.   Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.  *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*    O que oferecemos?    Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora  Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos   de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados  .  Mentorias semanais   com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.  Plataforma exclusiva   para acompanhamento das aulas.  Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.  Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.  Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).  Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.  Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.    Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?    Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.    Necessário:    Maior de 18 anos  , fluente em Português e outro idioma.  Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais   para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.  Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.  Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.    O diferencial?    Aqui você é mais que um professor.    Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas  , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.  Esta não é uma vaga CLT  , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.  Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.  Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii   com certeza é o seu lugar.  Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.   Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!  O que eu faço?    Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida  Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as  Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados  Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as  Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as  Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as    Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.  QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?    Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.  Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.  Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.    Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.  Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Data Analyst
description:

This is a fully remote, project-based position. You will be brought on as an independent contractor for an initial 3-month project, with the possibility of extending into a long-term role based on performance and ongoing need.   Company Overview    Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.  We're building a report powered entirely by real, proprietary compliance data and auditing experience. In this role, you'll help uncover the real story behind how insurance compliance actually works across real estate and construction: where processes break down at scale, where the biggest risks and operational strain hide, how teams can gain more control over their workflows, and where AI can help versus where human expertise still matters most. Your work will help Jones tell a sharper, more credible story about compliance - grounded entirely in real data.  Position Overview    As a Data Analyst Consultant, you'll determine which insights can be credibly supported by Jones' data and help define clear and defensible metrics. In doing so, you'll translate broad business questions into measures that reflect how Jones actually manages insurance compliance, documenting how each is defined, what data it draws on, and what limitations apply. You'll work with internal teams to access, clean, and analyze the relevant data, partnering closely with our insurance specialists to fact-check findings and ensure the analysis reflects real-world compliance behavior. The goal isn't simply to produce charts, but to understand what Jones' data can credibly and concretely reveal about the state of the industry and its dynamics - turning that understanding into clean, well-documented outputs that our Marketing team can build into a compelling, data-backed report.  What You’ll Do    Deliver a prioritized list of report insights that are feasible using Jones' proprietary data, including rationale for prioritization.  Work hands-on with complex, real-world operational data – including gaps, inconsistencies, and evolving definitions – applying sound judgement to clean and structure it for analysis, flagging any issues that could affect validity.  Develop structured, repeatable methods for processing and analyzing data.  Produce clean, analysis- and chart-ready data outputs (tables, aggregates, etc.).  Document methodology, data provenance, cleaning rules, assumptions, limitations, and required caveats for all analyses.  Collaborate closely with Jones' insurance specialists to validate that data interpretations match real-world compliance behavior and operational workflows.  Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Operations, responding to ad hoc requests for specific data cuts and insights.  Help shape decisions about what's ready to share publicly, balancing business impact with analytical rigor.  Summarize the strongest findings in a concise, executive-ready brief highlighting business relevance and confidence levels.    Who You Are    2+ years of data analysis experience, with strong SQL skills.  Experience working with SaaS, product, customer, or operations data.  Skilled at cleaning messy or incomplete datasets without losing analytical rigor.  Strong judgment in metric design, able to turn ambiguous questions into clear analysis.  Experience producing external-facing benchmarks or data-backed thought leadership  Excellent written and spoken English; can explain technical findings to non-technical teams.  Strong documentation habits.  Comfortable challenging assumptions when data doesn't support the desired narrative.  Available 40 hrs/week during U.S. business hours.    Why Join Jones    Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation  Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.  Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;  Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.  Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.  Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.  Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world  Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.    Our culture    Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:  Fall in love with problems –   We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.  Give help generously –   We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.  Own the outcome –   Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.  Take care of yourself –   Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.  Build trust everywhere –   Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.
