Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)    About the Company:    We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.  The Role:    We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.  This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.  Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.  We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.  What You'll Do:    Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.  Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.  Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.  Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.  Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.  Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.  Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.  Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.    What We're Looking For:    10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.  Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.  Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.  Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.  Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.  Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.  Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.  Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.  Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Relação com Investidores
description:

SOBRE A WHY CAPITAL :    A Why Capital é uma gestora de investimentos focada em ações listadas nos Estados Unidos, estruturada em uma estratégia de Fund of Funds. A gestora busca identificar e alocar capital nos melhores gestores dessa classe de ativos, realizando co-investimentos ao lado deles com uma visão de longo prazo.  Nossa filosofia de investimento é baseada na construção de um portfólio relativamente concentrado, composto por 20 a 30 empresas de alta qualidade, selecionadas por suas vantagens competitivas duradouras, elevado retorno sobre o capital investido (ROIC) e capacidade de capturar tendências estruturais de longo prazo, sustentando crescimento consistente ao longo dos anos. Com mentalidade de sócio e horizonte de investimento de longo prazo, a Why Capital prioriza paciência, baixa rotatividade do portfólio e decisões fundamentadas, evitando ruídos de curto prazo. Nosso objetivo é compor capital de forma consistente e sustentável ao longo dos anos, gerando retornos superiores para nossos investidores.  DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA   :  Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional de Relações com Investidores com perfil empreendedor para liderar o desenvolvimento de relacionamentos com profissionais de gestão de patrimônio e investidores institucionais em todo o Brasil. A principal missão será abrir novas oportunidades comerciais e construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com:  Multi Family Offices  Single Family Offices  Bancos Privados (Private Banks)  Gestores de Patrimônio Independentes  Assessores de Investimentos  Consultorias de Investimento Institucional  Outros parceiros estratégicos de distribuição    PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES   :  Desenvolver e executar a estratégia de distribuição da Why Capital em todo o Brasil.  Identificar e estabelecer relacionamento com os principais tomadores de decisão de investidores institucionais.  Agendar e coordenar reuniões com potenciais investidores e parceiros de distribuição.  Representar a Why Capital em reuniões, conferências e eventos do mercado financeiro.  Manter o CRM e o funil de captação organizados e atualizados.  Trabalhar em conjunto com o CIO na preparação de reuniões, materiais de acompanhamento e comunicações com investidores.  Coletar inteligência de mercado sobre preferências dos investidores.  Fortalecer a marca Why Capital e ampliar sua visibilidade junto à comunidade de Wealth Management no Brasil.  Apoiar todo o processo de captação de recursos, desde o primeiro contato até a entrada do investidor no fundo.    PERFIL DESEJADO   :  Experiência em Relações com Investidores, Vendas Institucionais, Private Banking, Wealth Management ou Asset Management.  Relacionamento prévio com Family Offices, Private Bankers ou Assessores de Investimentos será considerado um diferencial importante.  Forte perfil comercial e excelente habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal.  Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.  Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente, com elevado senso de responsabilidade e autonomia.  Perfil organizado, disciplinado e proativo.  Português fluente e inglês em nível profissional.    DIFERENCIAL DA VAGA   :  Esta não é uma posição em uma grande instituição com uma máquina de distribuição já estabelecida. É a oportunidade de ajudar a construir essa estrutura desde o início. Você trabalhará diretamente com o fundador da gestora, terá autonomia e desempenhará um papel central na definição da estratégia comercial da Why Capital. À medida que a empresa crescer, suas responsabilidades e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional crescerão na mesma proporção.  Buscamos alguém que queira construir algo relevante no longo prazo – e não apenas administrar uma carteira de relacionamentos já existente. O profissional selecionado terá a oportunidade de evoluir para uma posição de sócio da gestora ao longo do tempo, de acordo com seu desempenho e contribuição para o crescimento da empresa.  REMUNERAÇÃO   :  Salário fixo.  Bônus anual de até 12 salários, condicionado ao desempenho.  Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) vinculadas ao sucesso da captação de recursos, com período de vesting de 5 anos.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us    Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.  At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.  Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.  Role Overview    As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.  Key Responsibilities    1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)    Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.  Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.  Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.    2. Script-to-Audio Alignment    Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.  Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.    3. Technical & Creative Accuracy    Check audio for:  Voice clarity and consistency  Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness  Background noise or distortions  Timing and pacing issues  Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files  Grammatically incorrect words/sentences  Physical noise of voice artist  Abrupt cut / jerk  Sibilance  Fumble / mumble    4. Vendor & Artist Coordination    Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.    Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.    5. QC Documentation & Tracking    Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.  Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).  Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.    6. Pre-Release Quality Checks    Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.  Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.    7. Cross-Team Collaboration    Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.  Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.    8. Process Improvement    Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.  Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.  Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience  Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology    9. Volume & Deadline Management    Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content   within defined timelines.  Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.    10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:  Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns  Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress  Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation  Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses  Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes  Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery    Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.  Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.  Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.  Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.  Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.  Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.  Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.  Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.  Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.  Strong organizational and documentation skills.  Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.  Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.    Language requirements    Fluent Portugese  Professional working proficiency in English    This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.  Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!  Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.  If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!  Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.  What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?    You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.  If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.  When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!  In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:    Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!  You be your own boss and set your own schedule  Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).  Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:    Portuguese as a first language.  C1 or C2 Level English Speaker  University degree in English Teaching or related area.  One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.  Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.  Must pass a criminal background check.  Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:    Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Member of the Board of Advisors em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company    Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.  Company Website:      About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors    Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.  We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.  Key Responsibilities    Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.  Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.  Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.  Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.  Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.    Preferred Qualifications    Passion for football and the business of sports.  Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.  Strong professional network that can support club growth.  Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.  Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.    Compensation & Benefits    This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.  Why Join Us    Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham , our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.  Equal Opportunity Statement    Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.  Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Especialista jurídico
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista jurídico em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Missão    Assegurar que toda a operação de cobrança extrajudicial e judicial esteja em conformidade com a legislação vigente, garantindo segurança jurídica aos processos, mitigação de riscos e preservação da capacidade de recuperação de crédito. Atuar como referência técnica na estruturação, validação e melhoria dos fluxos de cobrança, preparando os casos para eventual judicialização e apoiando a empresa na tomada de decisões estratégicas relacionadas à recuperação de crédito.  Principais Responsabilidades    Estruturar e validar juridicamente toda a jornada de cobrança extrajudicial e judicial, assegurando conformidade legal e mitigação de riscos;  Elaborar pareceres jurídicos relacionados à recuperação de crédito, inadimplência, garantias, contratos e estratégias de execução;  Definir requisitos jurídicos para preparação dos casos destinados à judicialização, assegurando robustez documental e preservação da exigibilidade dos créditos;  Apoiar a construção e evolução das políticas de crédito, cobrança e recuperação de ativos sob a perspectiva jurídica;  Revisar e evoluir réguas de cobrança, notificações, acordos, comunicações e documentos jurídicos utilizados na operação;  Estruturar fluxos jurídicos padronizados, controles internos e procedimentos que aumentem segurança, rastreabilidade e eficiência operacional;  Participar da definição de estratégias jurídicas para novos produtos, serviços e operações estruturadas de crédito;  Atuar na implementação e evolução de ferramentas jurídicas (LegalTechs), apoiando a digitalização e automação dos processos da área;  Definir requisitos jurídicos para integrações sistêmicas, automações e novos fluxos operacionais;  Estruturar indicadores (KPIs), dashboards e controles gerenciais para acompanhamento da performance jurídica e da recuperação de crédito;  Atuar em parceria com as áreas de Crédito, Cobrança, Produto, Operações e Engenharia na construção de soluções escaláveis e juridicamente sustentáveis;  Avaliar riscos jurídicos de novas estratégias comerciais e operacionais, propondo alternativas que conciliem segurança jurídica e eficiência do negócio;  Coordenar tecnicamente escritórios parceiros, acompanhando estratégias processuais, indicadores de desempenho e qualidade das entregas;  Monitorar alterações legislativas, regulatórias e jurisprudenciais relacionadas ao crédito, agronegócio, recuperação de ativos, LGPD e Direito Processual Civil;  Disseminar conhecimento jurídico para as áreas de negócio, fortalecendo a cultura de prevenção de riscos e conformidade.    Requisitos    Graduação em Direito;  OAB ativa.  Experiência    Experiência consolidada em recuperação de crédito e cobrança judicial e extrajudicial;  Vivência em Direito Civil e Processo Civil;  Experiência em estruturação jurídica de operações de crédito, garantias ou recuperação de ativos;  Conhecimento em análise e elaboração contratual;  Experiência na interação com áreas de Crédito, Cobrança, Financeiro ou Operações;Conhecimento em LGPD aplicada à recuperação de crédito.    Diferenciais    Pós-graduação em Direito Empresarial, Processo Civil, Agronegócio, Recuperação de Crédito ou Compliance;  Experiência em empresas do agronegócio, fintechs, securitizadoras, FIDCs, FIAGROs ou instituições financeiras;  Vivência em operações estruturadas de crédito, barter, CPRs e garantias do agronegócio;  Experiência com LegalOps, implementação de softwares jurídicos e transformação digital;  Conhecimento em indicadores jurídicos, gestão por KPIs e análise de dados aplicada ao jurídico;  Experiência na coordenação de escritórios terceirizados e gestão estratégica do contencioso.    Competências Esperadas    Visão estratégica de negócio;  Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento sistêmico;  Excelente comunicação escrita e argumentação jurídica;  Capacidade de estruturar processos e promover melhoria contínua;  Organização, senso de prioridade e disciplina operaconal;  Autonomia, protagonismo e perfil \"hands-on\";  Facilidade para atuar em ambientes multidisciplinares e de rápida evolução;  Orientação para resultados e resolução de problemas complexos.    O que temos por aqui:    Trabalho remoto (encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos/SP)  Remuneração compatível (PJ)  Benefício flexível via cartão Swile  Wellhub (antigo Gympass)  Convênio médico Porto Saúde  Convênio odontológico Uniodonto

title: Analista de Operações Regulatórias Pleno

Você deve ser um pensador crítico e naturalmente interessado em aprender novos sistemas e processos para a agência e seu portfólio de marcas. Requisitos necessários:    • Bacharelado em Ciências Farmacêuticas ou área da saúde.  • 2 anos ou mais de experiência em indústria farmacêutica (áreas: marketing, médica ou relacionada).  • Compreensão do processo de revisão e aprovação de material promocional.  • Capacidade de conciliar vários projetos enquanto cumpre os prazos do cliente.  • Habilidades de planejamento, resolução de problemas, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo/organização.  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral.  • Fluência em inglês: leitura, interpretação de texto, escrita e fala, pois trabalhará diretamente com o time dos EUA no dia a dia.  • Altamente desejável: conhecimento do fluxo de revisão/aprovação de materiais no Veeva PromoMats, incluindo ancoragem e anotação de referências. Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map.  Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção.  APIs REST, gRPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos.  Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes.  Bancos relacionais, NoSQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding.  OAuth2, OpenID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade.  Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs).  Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs.  Experiência no setor Financeiro    Desejável:    Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture.  CQRS.  Event Sourcing.  Saga Pattern.  Outbox Pattern.  Consumer Driven Contracts.  GraphQL.  Apache Pulsar, RabbitMQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria.  Java, Go ou .NET.  Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS).  Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).  Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102).  TOGAF.  Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. title: Head of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Head of Finance- Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi    At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.  Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.  Position Overview    VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil   to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity.  Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business.  The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership.    Location    Remote – Brazil    Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.  Key Responsibilities    Financial Leadership    Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity.  Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives.  Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards.  Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership.    Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance    Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports.  Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations.  Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities.    Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations.  Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities.  Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.    Treasury & Banking    Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships.  Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements.  Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities.  Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure.    Financial Controls & Risk Management    Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance.  Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.  Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership.  Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes.    Cross-Functional Leadership    Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership.  Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning.  Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment.    Organizational Development    Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals.  Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth.  Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.    Qualifications    Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.  CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.  MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus.  10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.  Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions.  Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership.  Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements.  Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred.    Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills.  Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.    Desired Competencies    Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance      Nice to Have    Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.  Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations.  Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite.  Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs.  Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure.  Experience working within multinational or global organizations.  Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements.      Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)    Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:  Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.  Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.  Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.  Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.  Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.  Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.  Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.  Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.  Meet any additional \"fit and proper\" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.    Why Join VelaFi?    Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure.  As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil  , you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations.  This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments.  Equal Employment Opportunity    VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Planejador financeiro
description:
Empresa está contratando Planejador financeiro em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

A TKC Capital está expandindo sua área de Planejamento Patrimonial, Planejamento Financeiro e Proteção Patrimonial e busca profissionais que desejam construir uma carreira de longo prazo em um ambiente sofisticado, meritocrático e orientado à alta performance.  Somos um Multi Family Office independente que integra investimentos, planejamento financeiro, crédito estruturado, proteção patrimonial, planejamento tributário e ativos imobiliários de alto padrão em uma única plataforma.  Nosso propósito é oferecer soluções patrimoniais completas para clientes que exigem excelência.  Por que a TKC?  A maioria das instituições financeiras limita seus profissionais a uma única vertical de negócios.  Na TKC, você passa a atuar em um ecossistema integrado, capaz de atender praticamente todas as demandas patrimoniais de um cliente, fortalecendo relacionamentos, aumentando o ticket médio e ampliando significativamente seu potencial de geração de receita.  Você terá acesso a soluções em:  • Gestão Patrimonial e Investimentos  • Planejamento Financeiro  • Planejamento Tributário Estratégico  • Crédito Estruturado e Imobiliário  • Proteção Patrimonial (Seguros)  • Mercado Imobiliário Premium  Enquanto muitos profissionais precisam abrir mão de oportunidades por não possuírem determinada solução dentro da empresa em que trabalham, na TKC você entrega uma visão patrimonial completa, tornando-se muito mais relevante para seus clientes.  Você traz o relacionamento. A TKC entrega o ecossistema.  Grandes carreiras são construídas sobre confiança.  Sabemos que profissionais de alta performance desenvolvem relacionamentos ao longo de muitos anos. Por isso, criamos uma estrutura para que você possa dedicar seu tempo ao que realmente importa: atender clientes, gerar negócios e construir patrimônio.  Enquanto você se dedica ao relacionamento e à estratégia, a TKC oferece toda a estrutura necessária para transformar oportunidades em soluções completas.  Você contará com um backoffice especializado em:  • Operações e formalização  • Planejamento Financeiro  • Investimentos  • Crédito Estruturado e Imobiliário  • Seguros e Proteção Patrimonial  • Planejamento Tributário  • Mercado Imobiliário Premium  • Compliance e Suporte Operacional  Nosso papel é permitir que você atenda seus clientes com a estrutura, o suporte técnico e a especialização normalmente encontrados apenas nos grandes Multi Family Offices, sem precisar construir essa operação do zero.  Uma carreira construída por mérito  Na TKC, crescimento não depende de tempo de casa nem de política corporativa.  Nossa trilha de evolução é objetiva, transparente e baseada exclusivamente em performance.  Analista Patrimonial → Executivo Patrimonial → Executivo Sênior → Executivo Principal  Cada evolução representa aumento de responsabilidades, expansão da liderança e crescimento do percentual de comissionamento, podendo chegar a 40% sobre o honorário líquido, além da oportunidade de desenvolver sua própria equipe e evoluir para posições estratégicas dentro do ecossistema TKC.  Quem buscamos  Esta oportunidade foi desenhada especialmente para profissionais que já atuam ou atuaram em:  • Assessoria de Investimentos  • Private Banking  • Segmento Alta Renda ou Empresas  • Planejamento Financeiro  • Wealth Management  • Crédito Estruturado  • Seguros Patrimoniais  Mais do que experiência, buscamos profissionais que entendam que relacionamento é patrimônio, tenham visão de longo prazo e desejem construir uma carreira baseada em confiança, excelência e geração de valor para seus clientes.  Nosso modelo de remuneração  Acreditamos que profissionais de alta performance devem ser remunerados pelo valor que geram.  Por isso, esta posição não oferece salário fixo, ajuda de custo ou remuneração mínima garantida.  A remuneração é 100% variável, composta por comissões recorrentes e progressivas sobre os negócios desenvolvidos. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.  OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: FinCrime Analyst - Brazil
description:
Nova vaga disponível para FinCrime Analyst - Brazil em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.  As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.  People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.  About the role    Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.  We're looking for a FinCrime Analyst to review and get to the bottom of customer issues. You’ll collaborate with colleagues, both internally and externally, to solve cases and deliver an outstanding customer experience.  To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.  Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.  What you'll be doing    Conducting due diligence reviews of customers, businesses, and transactions using internal systems, screening tools, and external sources  Reviewing and investigating alerts generated by sanctions, PEP, KYC/KYB, and transaction monitoring systems to identify potential risks  Performing financial crime risk assessments to detect suspicious activity, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and other predicate offences  Escalating potential compliance, sanctions, or financial crime issues to relevant escalation teams, MLROs, or Compliance leadership  Validating customer and corporate documentation to ensure customer due diligence (CDD) and onboarding requirements meet internal policies and regulatory standards  Conducting risk-based reviews of individuals and entities (e.g., directors, shareholders, UBOs) to identify regulatory, fraud, and compliance risks  Analysing customer profiles, nature of business, and transactional activity to identify inconsistencies, red flags, or deviations from expected behaviour  Collaborating with internal stakeholders, including Support, Compliance, and Product teams to resolve complex cases and improve procedures    What you'll need    A bachelor's degree or equivalent  Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)  2+ years of FinCrime experience  Familiarity with investigative methodologies evidenced by use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)  A willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends  Critical thinking skills  Impeccable attention to detail  The ability to multitask, prioritise, and work well under pressure    Nice to have    A degree in law or STEM subject  A professional certification (ICA or ACAMS)  Fluency in other languages    Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.   Important notice for candidates:     Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.   •  Only apply through official Revolut channels.    We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.   •  Always double-check the emails you receive.    Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.   We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.    If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior Technical Product Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Please not that this is a 8month temp-to-perm independent contract  About hirework  s  hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. As your employer, hireworks will ensure you have a seamless interview, onboarding, and employee experience - providing ongoing support and resources along the way. Established in 2023, hireworks is forging corp-to-corp relationships with leading U.S. based organizations looking to grow their teams with best-in-class talent around the world. Working with hireworks means unlocking access to a network of local peers and mentors and career opportunities through our client network.  About Our Client & The Engagemen  t  Our client is a premier AI consulting group that builds serious, production-grade systems for companies ready to operationalize artificial intelligence across their business. They eschew gimmicks and prototypes, focusing instead on delivering custom AI that integrates seamlessly into operations to drive measurable results. Their work automates high-effort workflows, launches AI-powered product lines, and transforms internal data into structured, usable assets—ranging from custom-trained models to intelligent agents that reason across complex business logic. Their diverse clientele spans education, financial services, engineering, healthcare, and defense  About the Engagement    A multi-component platform build for an education-sector client: a cloud-native system that ingests school and rostering data into one canonical record, governs access down to the row and field, fronts it behind a single access layer, builds audiences from it, and delivers multi-channel communications to families at scale. It ships as five interlocking components, each with its own scope: a canonical data integration and migration platform; a capability-based access-control service; a unified API access layer over the core; an audience service; and an event-driven communications platform with consent and reporting. We are hiring two senior, interchangeable technical PMs. Each owns one or more components end to end and flexes across all five. You won't inherit a finished roadmap: you'll author scope, sequence delivery across interdependent teams, steer architecture with engineering, and run sign-off and rollout with the client.   What You Will Own    Turn ambiguous, architecture-heavy scope into sequenced roadmaps with clear milestones and acceptance criteria.  Govern scope and change as designs evolve through discovery, validation, and performance testing.  Hold the contracts and sequencing across deeply interdependent component teams.  Run client sign-off on schemas, policy models, SLAs, and migration cutover gates.  Define and track delivery metrics: success and lag rates, latency, dead-letters, and reconciliation tolerances.  Own phased rollout and migration per client: shadow mode, dual-run, cutover, and rollback.  Treat compliance as product requirements: FERPA, COPPA, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, TCPA, SOC 2, and data residency.  Partner with the client's product and engineering teams on PRDs, governance rules, and vendor selection.    Responsibilities    Own one or more components end to end: scope, roadmap, sequencing, risk, and client sign-off.  Author each component's scope and architecture narrative, and shepherd changes through client review.  Keep the interfaces between components coherent so dependent teams stay unblocked.  Set and hold acceptance criteria and quality gates for production-grade delivery.  Drive the migration and rollout playbook as reusable tooling: discovery, mapping, dual-run, cutover, rollback.  Translate between client business rules and engineering trade-offs: delivery semantics, replay, caching, latency.  Track delivery health against SLAs and surface risk early with clear recommendations.  Operate as a peer to senior engineering and client leadership in design reviews and sign-offs.    Required Experience    8+ years in product management, several as a senior, principal, or staff technical PM on platform or data-infrastructure products.  Track record shipping complex backend or platform products to production at scale (data, API, identity/auth, segmentation, or messaging).  Strong technical fluency: data modeling, event-driven systems, API contracts, authorization models, and cloud infra (GCP, AWS, or Azure).  Proven ownership of scope and change management on ambiguous, evolving engagements.  Cross-team dependency and interface management across interlocking services.  Strong stakeholder management; able to run and close schema, policy, and SLA sign-offs.  Large-scale data migration and phased rollout: dual-run, shadow mode, cutover, rollback.  Credible with engineers on distributed-systems trade-offs: idempotency, delivery semantics, replay, backpressure, latency.    Bonus    EdTech, SIS, or student-rostering experience.  Depth in data integration, access control (ABAC/RBAC), API gateways, segmentation, or messaging platforms.  Hands-on with a GCP-native stack (Dataflow/Beam, Spanner, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Terraform).  Senior consulting or client-services delivery experience. title: Consultor de Vendas
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Consultor de Vendas em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

⚠️ Requisito obrigatório  : nível avançado de espanhol.  Sobre a FieldData     A FieldData   é uma plataforma de gestão de dados para fazendas agrícolas e pecuárias, potencializada por inteligência artificial. Por meio do WhatsApp, qualquer pessoa — no campo ou no escritório — pode registrar informações utilizando mensagens de texto ou áudio. A plataforma transforma esses registros em dados estruturados, permitindo que administradores e proprietários acompanhem, em tempo real, indicadores, relatórios e análises sobre animais, lavouras e operações da fazenda.  Hoje, mais de 5.000 fazendas   já utilizam a FieldData, principalmente na pecuária de corte  , além de propriedades agrícolas. Atualmente, operamos na Argentina, Uruguai, Paraguai e Chile   e estamos expandindo nossa atuação para o Brasil  , onde buscamos um Consultor de Vendas   para impulsionar nosso crescimento no país.  A Função     Como Consultor de Vendas – Brasil  , você será responsável por apresentar a FieldData aos produtores rurais e parceiros comerciais, contribuindo diretamente para a expansão da empresa no mercado brasileiro.  Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:  Vendas diretas e desenvolvimento de parcerias:   gerenciar todo o ciclo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e o acompanhamento dos clientes.  Relacionamento com produtores:   realizar reuniões e demonstrações com produtores rurais brasileiros, mantendo contato frequente para compreender suas necessidades e incentivar a adoção da plataforma.  Evolução do produto:   atuar em parceria com as equipes de Produto e Tecnologia, levando feedbacks dos clientes e identificando oportunidades de melhorias e adaptações para atender às demandas do mercado brasileiro.  Expansão do mercado:   identificar oportunidades de negócio, desenvolver novos canais de venda e fortalecer o posicionamento da FieldData no Brasil.    Buscamos alguém que:     Tenha ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em Engenharia Agronômica, Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária   ou áreas correlatas.  Possua pelo menos 2 anos de experiência   no agronegócio, especialmente com produtores rurais.  Tenha experiência em vendas consultivas   de soluções AgTech, softwares para o agronegócio ou insumos agrícolas.  Possua nível avançado de espanhol   , suficiente para se comunicar com o time internacional.  Tenha perfil empreendedor  , seja proativo, orientado a resultados e goste de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.  Tenha boa capacidade de comunicação, negociação e construção de relacionamento com clientes e parceiros.  Tenha disponibilidade para realizar viagens e visitar produtores quando necessário.
